description: EXT3 NF-M1 closure part 2: HC real-space dipole (NSIDE=64, N_spiral(p)>=10 canonical mask, uniform-weight hp.fit_dipole, 10,000 per-pixel permutation null, seed 42 — c11b convention) recomputed on the baseline HC sample and on the HC sample excluding rows whose recovered flip-pass probabilities (p_flip = 2 p_eq - p_raw, any channel) fall outside [0,1] by more than 1e-3 (raw/eq pipeline-pass mismatch rows).
flag_definition: any recovered flip-pass probability outside [0,1] beyond 1e-3 using the full-coverage raw columns
conclusion: Excluding the flagged rows changes the HC real-space dipole z by the reported delta; the headline null-consistency of the HC dipole is robust to the flip-identity QC exclusion.
